subject: OPEN statement
notes: kb/Work PB317 LANDED 2026-09-05. RULE: 'The NO REWIND phrase will be ignored if it does not apply to the storage medium on which the file resides. If the NO REWIND phrase is ignored, the OPEN statement is successful and the I-O status associated with file-name-1 is set to 07.' (cite.py --check 14.9.27.4 -> OK, rule 11). The medium is fixed by 9.1.13.2 item 6 -- 07 is set when 'an OPEN statement with the NO REWIND phrase references a physical file on a non-reel/unit medium' (cite.py --check 9.1.13.2 -> OK, item 6) -- which is 14.9.6.4 GR2 category (a) Non-unit, the only category any sequential connector reports. FIX: the phrase leaves the parse tree. BoundOpen's per-file tuple became the named record BoundOpenFile carrying the phrase PER FILE-NAME (14.9.27.4 GR20 makes the mode, SHARING and RETRY the group's and the tape phrase the file-name's own); BOTH emitter arms carry it (the plain FileOpen and the sharing-aware FileOpenShared, since the phrases are independent and a statement may write both -- the two-arm trap this defect was an instance of); FileRegistry.NoRewindPhraseEffect is the ONE site of the rule, refusing any category but (a) LOUDLY and overlaying 07 only where the status' first digit is 0, because 14.9.27.4 GR25 a) reserves an unsuccessful open's own diagnosis. CODE-LOCATION RE-RECORDED by kb/Work PB668 2026-09-22, verdict and behaviour unchanged: CobolFile.OpenNoRewind became CobolFile.OpenTape, the ONE written-form entry for BOTH alternatives of 14.9.27.2's per-file-name bracket, taking an OpenTapePhrase rather than a bool -- because a bool per phrase is exactly what left the sibling alternative REVERSED unread at --std 85 for a year (PB668). GR11's effect site did not move. MEASURED before PB317: OPEN INPUT F WITH NO REWIND => 00, OPEN OUTPUT F WITH NO REWIND => 00 (CLOSE F WITH NO REWIND already 07). MEASURED after, and re-measured 2026-09-22 on the merged entry: 07, 07, 07. DETERMINATION (docs/CONFORMANCE.md section 3): where 9.1.13.2 item 4 a)'s 05 (an OPTIONAL INPUT file not present) would also apply, GR11's 07 governs -- GR11 is an explicit assignment in the statement clause, item 4 a) a description in the status-value clause, and 14.9.27.4 assigns 05 only in GR17, whose EXTEND/I-O modes SR6 bars from carrying the phrase. || EDITIONS AS ADJUDICATED: 1985 . 2002 . 2014 . 2023
